title: We need to make sure all repositories that has some value in any field of study or business are highlighted
body:
May be we should have not only single page, but separate page for all repositories which I worked on, and summary on how it can be useful in different fields.

We should also make categories with best repository examples for MLops, DevOPs, ML/AI, and other categories of IT professions where I can be useful.

As per https://github.com/konard/linksplatform the Links Platform development was started from around 2010, so that must be corrected.

```
1,460
Public repositories
```

There is no need to highlight any forks, only repositories that were created by me, or by organizations I was working in.

`npm · crates.io · NuGet` we should check also other package managers/registries.

So data can be collected more accurately, and we should double check we collect the full spectrum.

Also I used much more languages.

We also missing timeline for Deep.GPT project, that was developed at https://github.com/deep-assistant, where we had a chat bot with multiple functions like question answering, music generation, image generation and so on.

We should make more focus on github.com/link-foundation/meta-theory

Add nice cards about articles of Deep.Foundation at habr, as most of them were done with my participation.

So we have visual floating cards with articles, where it is dymically if possible loaded number of views, karma, boomarks and so on.

I also need a page for my blog, where we put deduplicate feed of my X, Telegram, VK public channels/walls.

So we do nice embeddings of posts from there, and if we have multiple posts similar to each other at the same time, we should show x version if it is in English, and user's language is English. And VK version if user's language is Russian.

And so on.

We also should be able to archive all these public posts with every formatting details, so if they get deleted at X, Telegram, VK, we still can show them without embeddings.

We need also to expand on languages and technologies that I have used.

We also need to have page where we can show only my ML/AI experience, DevOps experience, CEO/Team-lead experience, Software Developer experience and so on, so it will be easy to show only relevant experience.

Universal problem solving algorithm and Meta links theory should have more attention, we should also use the image of it.

For example - https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/1431904/404991709-1d91e911-9ba4-456e-a00a-14cdd60d9a0a.jpeg?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..oqthpCB-PwXFAmsmqW00UT0UJre3hJKEYxSXzzsaSGQ, or SVG version of it.

And we may use our links-visuals repository to make the style of the page much more tailored to what I do.

For example we can combine visuals from github.com/konard/links-visuals, to generate small SVG like simbols of all possible links configurations of 1-4 links, and do random matrix rain of them, all configurations must be done in the same size, meaning if we have 1 link it should take as much space as character/configuration of 2 or 3 or 4 links and so on.

So we have a universe image (may be simulated with high definition like gas or star cloud or something), after that grid, and on top of these 2 layers we should show a rain of symbols produced only from links, and on top of that we draw all our other infographics.

That should be done in the best possible quality so it will look inspiring.

For matrix data rain see - https://github.com/konard/twittermatrix

Also we should have separate page for associative stack i'm developing, and other art projects that yet to fit categories.

I also have repositories like tsp и p-vs-np and the same for physics, so that can be useful for researcher, data scientist work may include work with data collection from laws from countries and so on.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
